mode_source: explicit per-tick service-state label in raw input; no telemetry threshold or post-outcome classifier
noise_control: single_mode_noise keeps actual service at 4 and demand at 3, while its service telemetry independently samples the same {2,5} support as the positive service modes; this is a noisy observation control, not an actual service-collapse mechanism
safety_lane: independent protected capacity=1 tick each tick; fixture invariant requires served_safety=1 and safety_backlog=0
threshold_rule: For each metric independently, threshold is the maximum score over all pre-loss tick rows in all calibration episodes from the four named negative families; alarm only on strict greater-than. Therefore calibration false alarms are zero for every metric, giving equal calibration false-alarm burden. No held-out data enters threshold selection.
recovery_comparator: #5776 T0-v2 fixed-probe recovery-duration ratio: latest completed probe recovery duration divided by first completed duration; emitted only after at least two recoveries. Probe adds one demand unit at each preregistered tick for one tick.
endpoint: first tick beginning a run of 3 consecutive rows with queue >= 10; endpoint is the first row of that run, determined independently after event generation
mode_threshold_sensitivity: Not applicable: mode labels are explicit source-bound simulator states, not thresholded telemetry. Any result requiring inferred/thresholded modes is HOLD_ENCODING and outside this allocation.
